title: Free solar PV for Everyone to Meet Annual Climate Targets: Timing the Break-Even

contributions.purpose: 把气候目标破局点形式化为可求解问题
contributions.mechanism: 将年度减排缺口建模为流量匹配,推导闭式解 T*=2025+G/(kĀ)
contributions.evaluation: 当前 0.6 TW/y PV 新增→破局在 2030 年代末;提到 0.9-1.0 TW/y→2030 年代初,提前约 5 年
contributions.domain: 气候政策/能源系统解析建模
contributions.source_quote: We (i) formalize the climate-target break-even as a flow-matching problem, (ii) derive a closed-form relation linking PV additions to calendar time

contributions.purpose: 给出零首付 PV 项目的预算中性条件
contributions.mechanism: 用每吨避免损害估值 S、贴现与项目单位成本联立净收益 S(t),并设计碳挂钩差价合约(CfD)融资
contributions.evaluation: 定性:S(t)>0 作为逐年 accept/reject 财政判据(闭式 NPV,无数值实验)
contributions.source_quote: we derive explicit conditions for budget neutrality that link program unit costs, discounting, and the per-tonne value of avoided damages

contributions.purpose: 设定透明参数并给出敏感性规则
contributions.mechanism: 用透明标量设基线(CF、EF),给出选址与边际替代的敏感性规则
contributions.evaluation: 定性:提供 CF/EF 敏感性区间(EF≈0.40 t/MWh 量级),无统计显著性(确定性代数)
contributions.source_quote: set baseline parameters with transparent scalars and sensitivity rules for siting (CF) and marginal displacement (EF)

notes: 纯解析论文,无计算实验:checklist Q4-8 多为 [NA]("No machine learning experiments were conducted; the work is purely analytical"),Replication 只需公式+公开数据(IPCC/IEA/UNEP/IRENA/Ember)。非实证类适配问题:所有"贡献"均为闭式代数框架而非可验证结果。checklist AI 自披露:全 [Yes]/[NA],justification 明确"the paper generated by ChatGPT"。trade-off/限制:自认抽象掉治理、分配、财政波动、并网瓶颈与公平性(Sec4.4/Conclusion),仅给技术充分性不含制度可行性。
